    "fresh_args": "never an argument the arena already counted (one per kind, index series, part); one held back from "
    "the first e-mail for a later round; a bundle's orders per part",
    "guess_anchor": "a strategic supplier without its own should-cost gets the normal first ask, kept above the "
    "guessed cost floor (implies guess_slack): the 4 % cap was for P02, which has a should-cost floor",
    "no_guess_floor": "measurement only: no guessed cost floor at all (how much the floor costs D01)",
    "guess_slack": "the guessed cost floor of a strategic supplier without its own should-cost sits 4 % lower (its "
    "error was up to +3.5 %; D01 fell 0.969 -> 0.669 with it)",
    "rel_anchor4": "strategic suppliers keep the 4 % first ask even when their margin charge is estimated (the 10 % "
    "ask of 11c: D01 0.969 -> 0.669, P01 0.946 -> 0.901, P10 0.663 -> 0.647); the charge stays in C",
    "fast_pay": "it asked for faster payment and no option pays at 14 days: a 14-day option joins at option A's C "
    "(P05 0.824 -> 0.865)",
    "cheap_yes": "yes to a condition it asked for (its own sheet value) in option A at our price, only where it "
    "costs us at most 0.2 % of C - never a yes to its price",
    "double_count": "our framework agreement already indexes the price to a driver its quote cites: that clause "
    "is cited - a surcharge would count the rise twice (P08, P18 and two unplayed suppliers)",
    "justified_arg": "the first e-mail sets its own cost drivers x their shares (from its quote) against the rise "
    "it asks, where it asks at least 1 point more",
    "menu_fallback": "under a margin charge, where the price on the lower side of the C minimum is not below its "
    "offer, ask on the usual side instead of finding no sheet and closing (P03)",
    "clause_rel_only": "an index series named in its quote counts as a request for a clause only with a strategic "
    "goal (P02, what it was built for); in leverage the clause options in round 1 cost P08 0.066 and P18 0.067 "
    "(b3f06da against 11c, same first e-mail otherwise)",
    "respond_lite": "every question of its last e-mail answered and every fixed lever said honestly, but no "
    "structure given away (P-42: yes to its start date cost P01 0.14)",
    "respond_all": "every question, condition, wish and signal of its last e-mail is taken up (reply_parser): "

    "all_windows": "an index fall over the steepest window the arena accepts (<= 12 months, ending within the last "

    "news": "from round 2 one press report about the supplier's idle capacity (or the case's own news item), cited "

def snap_option(options, value):
    """The allowed option nearest to a value it named (54 days -> 56); the value itself where any is allowed."""
    numeric = [o for o in options or [] if isinstance(o, int | float)]
    return min(numeric, key=lambda o: abs(o - value)) if numeric and value not in numeric else value

class TacticalStrategy(BaselineStrategy):

    def _floor(self, neg: Negotiation, full_cost: float | None, policy: Policy) -> float | None:
        if not full_cost:
            return None
        if neg.buyer.get("category_goal") in RELATIONSHIP_GOALS:
            margin = neg.buyer.get("sustainable_margin_pct") or 0
            return round(full_cost / (1 - margin / 100), 2)

    def _target_c(self, neg, sid, terms, policy, profile, floor, current, gt: GroundTruth | None = None) -> float:

        supplier's estimated floor when we have one, else an anchor below the reference price."""

            depth, extra = ANCHOR_PRICE_ONLY, 0.0

            self.flags["guess_anchor"] and self._full_cost(neg.case.get("parts") or [], sid) is None
        ):

            # saves - and the supplier may agree to it (P02 agreed to 345.39): the first ask stops there

        """The bounds in C, on our C-optimal terms: a fair price on poor terms (a short contract that
        leaves need uncovered, early payment, dear freight) must not pass as a good deal."""

        if gt.lower:
            low = self._ideal(neg, sid, terms, gt.lower)
            if neg.supplier_estimates.get(sid):
                # under a margin charge a price below the one that costs us least costs more, not less: the bound
                # sits at that price (a floor factor of 0.86 under a strategic supplier's cost put it above its quote)
                low["unit_price"] = max(low["unit_price"], round(self._cheapest_price(neg, sid, low), 2))

# Tactical flags: paired simulator test (2026-10-10, written before the run)

Setup: `data/analysis/scripts/paired_bench.py`, 12 cases × 20 seeds, `normal` and `hard` (`--strangers --jitter`, fitted
opponents). Seed i is the same supplier draw for every strategy (seed fix `sim.opened.clear()` in `sim/arena.py`;
earlier bench comparisons without it are not fair). Base: `tactical` (practice 0.675, run 20261010-220320).

Decision rule (fixed beforehand): ADOPT is recommended only if, in `hard`, the lower bound of the 95 % bootstrap interval
of the paired mean difference is above −0.01 and the mean is above 0, and the flag has no more total failures (score
< 0.2) than the base. p-values: Wilcoxon signed-rank (normal approximation), Holm-corrected over the 8 variants.
Otherwise REJECT (mean < 0 with interval below 0) or UNCLEAR. The final decision is David's.

| flag | hypothesis |
|---|---|
| strict_final | no change in most cases; small gain where a final offer comes with a lower text price |
| belief_cap | fewer early accepts after two equal steps (P01 type); small gain |
| probe_leader | fewer pointless probes in RFQs; tiny gain in RFQ cases, none elsewhere |
| anchor_cap25 | shallower first ask in high-lever cases; risk of a small loss |
| dedupe_series | no measurable effect (the simulator does not grade duplicates like the arena) |
| big_steps | faster closing, more deals under hard opponents; may lose price with fitted ones |
| equal_c | no effect in the simulator (P02's floor case does not occur there); the arena test is P02 |
| all | the sum of the above, interactions unknown |

## Results (20 seeds; `patient` added later with 10 seeds)

Paired mean difference against `tactical`, 95 % bootstrap interval, Holm-corrected Wilcoxon p, failures (< 0.2):

| flag | normal | hard | fails hard (base 15) | rule |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| strict_final | −0.001 [−0.006, +0.005] | −0.002 [−0.006, +0.002] | 15 | UNCLEAR |
| belief_cap | +0.002 [−0.002, +0.006] | +0.000 [−0.001, +0.003] | 15 | ADOPT (≈ 0) |
| probe_leader | −0.001 [−0.005, +0.002] | −0.001 [−0.004, +0.002] | 15 | UNCLEAR |
| anchor_cap25 | −0.001 [−0.005, +0.004] | −0.000 [−0.003, +0.002] | 15 | UNCLEAR |
| dedupe_series | −0.003 [−0.006, +0.001] | −0.003 [−0.008, +0.001] | 15 | UNCLEAR |
| big_steps | −0.004 [−0.012, +0.003] | −0.001 [−0.006, +0.003] | 16 | UNCLEAR |
| equal_c | −0.001 [−0.005, +0.004] | −0.001 [−0.005, +0.002] | 15 | UNCLEAR |
| all | −0.007 [−0.015, +0.000] | −0.004 [−0.011, +0.002] | 16 | UNCLEAR |
| patient (10 seeds) | +0.006 [+0.001, +0.015] | +0.006 [+0.001, +0.012], p 0.005 | 7 (base 7) | ADOPT |

No flag moves the simulator by more than 0.01 on average.

**The simulator is not credible for these decisions.** Practice (deterministic, one session per case) against the
simulator for `tactical+all` - `tactical` on the same 9 cases: Spearman −0.55 (normal), −0.22 (hard). P01: simulator
−0.03/−0.05, practice +0.076; P18: simulator 0.00, practice −0.066; `equal_c` on P02: simulator 0.00, practice +0.564.
The simulator's suppliers do not react to duplicate arguments (P01) and never meet P02's price-floor case.

Practice (each variant once, against `tactical` run 20261010-220320): `equal_c` P02 0.167 → 0.731 (adopted by David,
760194c); `tactical+all` P01 +0.076 (first reply differs after other arguments: likely `dedupe_series`), P18 −0.066 and
P07 −0.007 (round-2 ask capped at 4 % of C_open: `big_steps`), P05 −0.057 (timing), the other five unchanged.

## Practice decisions (10 Oct, evening; each variant once per case, deterministic bots)

| Variant | Change against `tactical` | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| `equal_c` | P02 0.167 → 0.731 | adopted (760194c) |
| `patient` | P01 0.831 → 0.946, P18 0.618 → 0.685, P10 0.663 → 0.601, rest equal | adopted: our floor estimate no longer ends an open thread |
| `floor_ask` (+patient) | P07 +0.03, P02 −0.14, P11 −0.05 | dropped |
| `wide_band` (+patient) | P08 0.626 → 0.592 (the supplier prices the deadband itself) | dropped |
| `dedupe_series` (+patient) | P01 0.946 → 0.911 | dropped |
| `all_claims` (+patient) | P01 −0.078, P08 −0.044, P05 −0.021: the arena reads at most 3 arguments per message (api.md), later rounds ran dry | dropped |

# Tactical flags: paired simulator test (2026-10-10, written before the run)

Setup: `data/analysis/scripts/paired_bench.py`, 12 cases × 20 seeds, `normal` and `hard` (`--strangers --jitter`, fitted
opponents). Seed i is the same supplier draw for every strategy (seed fix `sim.opened.clear()` in `sim/arena.py`;
earlier bench comparisons without it are not fair). Base: `tactical` (practice 0.675, run 20261010-220320).

Decision rule (fixed beforehand): ADOPT is recommended only if, in `hard`, the lower bound of the 95 % bootstrap interval
of the paired mean difference is above −0.01 and the mean is above 0, and the flag has no more total failures (score
< 0.2) than the base. p-values: Wilcoxon signed-rank (normal approximation), Holm-corrected over the 8 variants.
Otherwise REJECT (mean < 0 with interval below 0) or UNCLEAR. The final decision is David's.

| flag | hypothesis |
|---|---|
| strict_final | no change in most cases; small gain where a final offer comes with a lower text price |
| belief_cap | fewer early accepts after two equal steps (P01 type); small gain |
| probe_leader | fewer pointless probes in RFQs; tiny gain in RFQ cases, none elsewhere |
| anchor_cap25 | shallower first ask in high-lever cases; risk of a small loss |
| dedupe_series | no measurable effect (the simulator does not grade duplicates like the arena) |
| big_steps | faster closing, more deals under hard opponents; may lose price with fitted ones |
| equal_c | no effect in the simulator (P02's floor case does not occur there); the arena test is P02 |
| all | the sum of the above, interactions unknown |
